newsitem.title: UK: Stg/mark consolidates in Europe, cable trends up.
newsitem.headline: Stg/mark consolidates in Europe, cable trends up.

text.p: 1220 GMT - Sterling/mark slips off highs in Europe after two pfennig rise in morning session. Cable rangebound but trending higher.
* Pound at 2.7888/98 marks compared to 2.7720/30 in late Wednesday Europe, but down from high of 2.7938. Cable at $1.6388/98 vs $1.6391/96.
* Traders say Bundesbank/Bonn rift over asset revaluation plan seen as worrying for EMU start and buoying sterling.
* UK EU-harmonised CPI index up 1.6 pct in year to April. UK April non-EU trade deficit 335 million stg vs expected 600 million, UK March EU trade deficit 20 million, global shortfall 671 million.
